title: wsl-agent-sandbox Central Windows Secrets Manifest
description: Central Windows-side manifest used by '.\box.ps1 seed-secrets' to seed and rotate CLI machine account tokens and service account credentials inside WSL without storing secrets in git or exposing Windows directories to the sandbox.

github.description: GitHub CLI (gh) and git HTTPS credential helper using a machine account or fine-grained PAT.

tokenFile.description: Windows path (relative to manifest directory or absolute, supports %ENVVAR%) to a file containing the token.

tokenEnv.description: Name of a Windows environment variable containing the token.

gitProtocol.description: Git protocol recorded in ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml. When set to 'ssh', configure the dedicated 'git' service for Git SSH keys and hosts.

setupGit.description: Configure git credential helper via 'gh auth setup-git'.

exportEnv.description: Also export GH_TOKEN (or GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN for non-github.com hosts) in secrets.env.

loginOnline.description: If true, authenticate via 'gh auth login --with-token' (validates token online against GitHub API).

proxyInject.description: If true, keep real token in root-only credential-proxy state and give agent a placeholder token.

ttl.description: Optional auto-expiration duration (e.g. '30m', '2h', '1d', '90s') enforced by a root systemd timer; overridden by CLI -Ttl.

git.description: Dedicated Git SSH authentication keys, Git host entries in ~/.ssh/config, pinned known_hosts, optional Git identity (user.name/user.email), SSH commit/tag signing, and optional HTTPS-to-SSH URL rewrites.

userName.description: Optional global Git author/committer name (user.name) written to managed gitconfig.

userEmail.description: Optional global Git author/committer email (user.email) written to managed gitconfig.

ttl.description: Optional auto-expiration duration (e.g. '30m', '2h', '1d', '90s') enforced by a root systemd timer; overridden by CLI -Ttl.

host.description: Shorthand Git SSH host used with top-level privateKey* when 'hosts' is omitted (e.g. 'github.com', 'gitlab.com', 'ssh.dev.azure.com').

user.description: Default SSH username for managed Git hosts (defaults to 'git').

port.description: Optional SSH port for shorthand single-host mode.

privateKey.description: Shorthand inline SSH private key for single-host mode (mutually exclusive with 'keys').

privateKeyFile.description: Shorthand Windows path (relative to manifest directory or absolute, supports %ENVVAR%) to an SSH private key.

privateKeyEnv.description: Shorthand Windows environment variable name containing an SSH private key.

certificate.description: Optional OpenSSH signed user certificate (*-cert.pub) for shorthand mode.

rewriteHttpsToSsh.description: Optional default: rewrite https://<hostName>/ URLs to SSH via git url.<ssh>.insteadOf.

defaultKey.description: Optional default key name from git.keys used by git.hosts entries that do not specify their own key or privateKey*.

strictHostKeyChecking.description: Optional default StrictHostKeyChecking policy for managed Git hosts. Defaults per host to 'yes' when pinned knownHosts cover that host, otherwise 'accept-new'.

identitiesOnly.description: Default IdentitiesOnly setting for managed Git hosts (recommended: true).

forwardAgent.description: Default ForwardAgent setting for managed Git hosts (recommended: false).

serverAliveInterval.description: Optional default SSH keepalive interval in seconds (ServerAliveInterval).

connectTimeout.description: Optional default SSH connection timeout in seconds (ConnectTimeout).

batchMode.description: Default BatchMode setting for Git SSH hosts (default: true so autonomous agents fail fast rather than hanging on interactive prompts).

knownHosts.description: Optional list of OpenSSH known_hosts lines for Git hosts written to ~/.ssh/wsl-agent-sandbox-git/known_hosts.

knownHostsFile.description: Optional Windows path (relative to manifest directory or absolute, supports %ENVVAR%) to a known_hosts file for Git hosts.

keys.description: Named Git SSH private keys (plus optional public keys and OpenSSH signed user certificates) stored under ~/.ssh/wsl-agent-sandbox-git/.

privateKeyFile.description: Windows path (relative to manifest directory or absolute, supports %ENVVAR%) to an SSH private key.

privateKeyEnv.description: Name of a Windows environment variable containing the SSH private key.

hosts.description: Git SSH Host entries merged into a dedicated managed block in ~/.ssh/config (independent of the 'ssh' service).

name.description: SSH Host alias (e.g. 'github.com', 'gitlab.com', 'ssh.dev.azure.com', or per-repo alias 'github-myrepo').

hostName.description: Remote Git SSH hostname or IP (defaults to 'name' if omitted).

user.description: Remote Git SSH username (defaults to git.user, i.e. 'git').

key.description: Name of a key defined in git.keys (mutually exclusive with privateKey*).

knownHost.description: Optional OpenSSH known_hosts line(s) for this Git host.

knownHostFile.description: Optional Windows path to a known_hosts file for this Git host.

rewriteHttpsToSsh.description: If true, configure git url.<ssh>.insteadOf for https://<hostName>/ (non-wildcard aliases only).

signing.description: Optional Git SSH commit and tag signing (gpg.format = ssh) written to ~/.config/wsl-agent-sandbox/gitconfig.

key.description: Name of a key in git.keys (or 'default' for top-level shorthand key); mutually exclusive with privateKey*.

allowedSigners.description: Optional OpenSSH allowed_signers lines (e.g. 'sandbox-bot@example.com namespaces="git" ssh-ed25519 AAAA...').

allowedSignersFile.description: Optional Windows path to an allowed_signers file.

aws.description: AWS CLI v2 IAM access keys / STS credentials merged into ~/.aws/credentials and ~/.aws/config.

ttl.description: Optional auto-expiration duration (e.g. '30m', '2h', '1d', '90s') enforced by a root systemd timer; overridden by CLI -Ttl.

profiles.description: Optional list of multiple named AWS profiles.

gcloud.description: Google Cloud CLI (gcloud) and GCP SDKs authenticated via a Service Account JSON key.

serviceAccountKeyFile.description: Windows path (relative to manifest directory or absolute, supports %ENVVAR%) to a GCP Service Account JSON key file.

serviceAccountKeyJson.description: Optional inline GCP Service Account JSON key.

project.description: Optional GCP project ID (defaults to project_id inside the Service Account key).

setApplicationDefaultCredentials.description: Export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS pointing to the seeded key file.

skipActivate.description: If true, place the key file and configure project/env without calling 'gcloud auth activate-service-account' online.

ttl.description: Optional auto-expiration duration (e.g. '30m', '2h', '1d', '90s') enforced by a root systemd timer; overridden by CLI -Ttl.

azure.description: Microsoft Azure CLI (az) and Azure SDKs authenticated via an Entra ID Service Principal.

certificateFile.description: Windows path to a PEM certificate file (mutually exclusive with clientSecret).

subscription.description: Optional default subscription ID or name.

skipLogin.description: If true, only export env/cert without calling 'az login --service-principal' online.

ttl.description: Optional auto-expiration duration (e.g. '30m', '2h', '1d', '90s') enforced by a root systemd timer; overridden by CLI -Ttl.

azureDevops.description: Azure DevOps CLI ('az devops') authenticated via Personal Access Token (AZURE_DEVOPS_EXT_PAT).

ttl.description: Optional auto-expiration duration (e.g. '30m', '2h', '1d', '90s') enforced by a root systemd timer; overridden by CLI -Ttl.

jira.description: Jira CLI (ankitpokhrel/jira-cli) configured via ~/.config/.jira/.config.yml and JIRA_API_TOKEN.

proxyInject.description: If true, keep real token in root-only credential-proxy state and give agent a placeholder token.

ttl.description: Optional auto-expiration duration (e.g. '30m', '2h', '1d', '90s') enforced by a root systemd timer; overridden by CLI -Ttl.

upcloud.description: UpCloud CLI (upctl) configured via ~/.config/upctl.yaml and optional UPCLOUD_TOKEN.

ttl.description: Optional auto-expiration duration (e.g. '30m', '2h', '1d', '90s') enforced by a root systemd timer; overridden by CLI -Ttl.

kubectl.description: Kubernetes CLI (kubectl) configured via a kubeconfig file or direct Service Account bearer token.

kubeconfigFile.description: Windows path to a dedicated sandbox kubeconfig file.

context.description: Optional context name to activate with 'kubectl config use-context'.

server.description: Kubernetes API server URL (for token-based kubeconfig generation).

caCertFile.description: Optional Windows path to cluster CA PEM file (for token-based kubeconfig).

ttl.description: Optional auto-expiration duration (e.g. '30m', '2h', '1d', '90s') enforced by a root systemd timer; overridden by CLI -Ttl.

gemini.description: Gemini CLI API key or Vertex AI environment configuration.

proxyInject.description: If true, keep real API key in root-only credential-proxy state and give agent a placeholder token.

ttl.description: Optional auto-expiration duration (e.g. '30m', '2h', '1d', '90s') enforced by a root systemd timer; overridden by CLI -Ttl.

claude.description: Claude Code API key or OAuth token configuration.

proxyInject.description: If true, keep real API key in root-only credential-proxy state and give agent a placeholder token.

ttl.description: Optional auto-expiration duration (e.g. '30m', '2h', '1d', '90s') enforced by a root systemd timer; overridden by CLI -Ttl.

ssh.description: SSH private keys, optional OpenSSH user certificates, remote server Host entries in ~/.ssh/config, and pinned known_hosts for autonomous agent remote server access.

defaultKey.description: Optional name of a key in ssh.keys to use as the default IdentityFile in a managed 'Host *' fallback stanza.

strictHostKeyChecking.description: Optional default StrictHostKeyChecking policy. Defaults to 'yes' when pinned knownHosts are provided, otherwise 'accept-new'.

identitiesOnly.description: Default IdentitiesOnly setting for managed hosts (recommended: true).

forwardAgent.description: Default ForwardAgent setting for managed hosts (recommended: false).

serverAliveInterval.description: Optional default SSH keepalive interval in seconds (ServerAliveInterval).

connectTimeout.description: Optional default SSH connection timeout in seconds (ConnectTimeout).

batchMode.description: Optional default BatchMode setting (true disables interactive password/passphrase prompts so agents fail fast).

ttl.description: Optional auto-expiration duration (e.g. '30m', '2h', '1d', '90s') enforced by a root systemd timer; overridden by CLI -Ttl.

knownHosts.description: Optional list of OpenSSH known_hosts lines (e.g. from ssh-keyscan) written to ~/.ssh/wsl-agent-sandbox/known_hosts.

knownHostsFile.description: Optional Windows path (relative to manifest directory or absolute, supports %ENVVAR%) to a known_hosts file.

keys.description: Named SSH private keys (plus optional public keys and OpenSSH signed user certificates) stored under ~/.ssh/wsl-agent-sandbox/.

privateKeyFile.description: Windows path (relative to manifest directory or absolute, supports %ENVVAR%) to an SSH private key.

privateKeyEnv.description: Name of a Windows environment variable containing the SSH private key.

hosts.description: Remote server Host entries merged into a managed block in ~/.ssh/config.

hostName.description: Remote server hostname or IP address (HostName).

key.description: Name of a key defined in ssh.keys (mutually exclusive with privateKey*).

knownHost.description: Optional OpenSSH known_hosts line(s) for this host.

knownHostFile.description: Optional Windows path to a known_hosts file for this host.

env.description: Additional machine account tokens or API keys exported into ~/.config/wsl-agent-sandbox/secrets.env.

files.description: Additional secret files copied atomically from Windows into paths strictly inside /home/<agent>/.

sourcePath.description: Windows path (relative to manifest directory or absolute, supports %ENVVAR%).

targetPath.description: Linux target path strictly inside /home/<agent>/ (may start with '~/').
